title: Harden the wasm FFI surface: bounds, null checks, panic hook, tests
description:
`crates/apricity-web/src/lib.rs` has 74 `unsafe` mentions and zero tests.

- `rw_arrange` passes caller JSON into `Renderer::arrange`, which indexes `tl.sources[e.source]` without a bounds check (`crates/apricity-engine/src/render.rs:97`). A malformed timeline panics; in wasm that is a trap with no message because no panic hook is installed.
- `rw_engine_load` (263) and `rw_engine_load_mastered` (304) rebuild a `Vec` with `Vec::from_raw_parts(data, 2*frames, 2*frames)` with no null check and no overflow check on `2*frames`.
- `str_arg` (85) silently turns invalid UTF-8 into an empty string.
- `RESULT` is a thread-local `String` whose pointer is handed to the caller and invalidated on the next call.
- `rw_engine_process` (347) is not covered by the allocation-counting test in `crates/apricity-engine/tests/realtime.rs`.

Done when: every entry point validates its inputs and returns an error code or message instead of panicking; a panic hook forwards messages to the host; the safe inner functions have a native test harness; the allocation test covers the wasm process path.
